business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells nutritional supplements and health food products in the PRC, Australia and New Zealand, with 2023 growth mainly from Good Health cross-border e-commerce platforms and infant and child distributor channels in the PRC.

segments.item: Good Health and health food products
segments.business_substance: Revenue from nutritional supplements and health food products; management discussion attributes growth to Good Health cross-border e-commerce and infant/child distributor channels.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, Management Discussion and Analysis, pp. 15-16; Note 1, p. 143

business_overview.revenue_model: Manufacture, processing, trading and retail of health food and nutritional supplement products through e-commerce, distributors, pharmacies and retail channels.
business_notes: Revenue increased 105.2% to RMB563.959 million in 2023.
Gross margin rose to 67.3%, mainly because cross-border e-commerce platforms carried a higher share of revenue.
Selling and distribution expenses were RMB249.962 million, 44.3% of revenue, reflecting heavy advertising and promotion.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2023 profit converted reasonably into operating cash, but the positive year follows losses in 2021 and 2022. Inventory increased RMB34.183 million and trade receivables increased RMB4.387 million; trade payables partly funded the build. Treat 2023 cash earnings as a one-year base and apply a large sustainability haircut.

evidence.business_substance: Annual report audited by certified public accountants; board approved consolidated financial statements on 26 March 2024.
evidence.source: Annual Report 2023, Independent Auditor's Report and Note 35, pp. 132-135, 230

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent versus every subsidiary; only the parent company cash balance and consolidated currency split are disclosed.
The annual report gives 2021 net profit in the five-year summary but not the full 2021 operating cash flow in the 2023 annual report.
Maintenance capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; cash paid to acquire property, plant and equipment is used conservatively.
